behavior: Every repository that runs PR-Agent, except dotfiles, calls the shared workflow pinned by full SHA.
verification: for r in garsync hive iris kubelab leaving-denver mail2markdown pdf-modifier pollex svqtriana.github.io ts-bridge web yt-metrics-cli; do gh api repos/mlorentedev/$r/contents/.github/workflows/pr-agent.yml --jq .content | base64 -d | grep -qE 'ci-workflows/.github/workflows/pr-agent.yml@[0-9a-f]{40}' || echo $r; done | (! grep .)

behavior: No adopter keeps a copy of the review steps.
verification: for r in garsync hive iris kubelab leaving-denver mail2markdown pdf-modifier pollex svqtriana.github.io ts-bridge web yt-metrics-cli; do gh search code 'The-PR-Agent/pr-agent' --repo mlorentedev/$r --json path --jq '.[].path' | sed "s|^|$r: |"; done | (! grep .)

behavior: Each adopter's .pr_agent.toml holds only what differs from the base and asks for the Class line as fork 2 decides.
verification: manual per adopter PR, recorded in verification.md, until fork 2 is decided

behavior: Every adopter PR gets a PR-Agent review from the shared workflow, and no batch loses a review to NaN's slot limit.
verification: per adopter PR: gh api repos/mlorentedev/<repo>/issues/<pr>/comments --jq '[.[]|select(.user.login=="github-actions[bot]" and (.body|test("PR Reviewer Guide")))]|length' is at least 1
